programs.source:
symbols = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
codes = [
    ".-",
    "-...",
    "-.-.",
    "-..",
    ".",
    "..-.",
    "--.",
    "....",
    "..",
    ".---",
    "-.-",
    ".-..",
    "--",
    "-.",
    "---",
    ".--.",
    "--.-",
    ".-.",
    "...",
    "-",
    "..-",
    "...-",
    ".--",
    "-..-",
    "-.--",
    "--..",
    "-----",
    ".----",
    "..---",
    "...--",
    "....-",
    ".....",
    "-....",
    "--...",
    "---..",
    "----.",
]
table = dict(zip(symbols, codes))
reverse = {code: symbol for symbol, code in table.items()}
message = "MEET ME AT PIER 9 AT 1745"
encoded = " / ".join(
    " ".join(table[char] for char in word) for word in message.split(" ")
)
decoded = " ".join(
    "".join(reverse[code] for code in word.split(" ")) for word in encoded.split(" / ")
)
print(encoded)
print(decoded)
